name: RingCentral Chat
description:
Connect Claude to RingCentral Team Chat to streamline your daily workplace communication, team management, and workspace organization without switching tabs. This integration is currently in Beta as we actively refine features and gather user feedback.

Key Features:

Messaging & Conversations: Draft, send, and reply to messages in teams or direct conversations directly from Claude.

Smart Team Discovery & Management: Search for relevant teams, join or leave teams, and manage team members (subject to user permissions).

Rich Content & Adaptive Cards: Send Adaptive Cards for rich, interactive, and structured message presentations in team chats.

Event & Task Management: Create, retrieve, and update shared artifacts, including team tasks, notes, calendar events, and code snippets to keep team workflows organized.

Designed for individuals and teams who want to leverage AI to automate administrative chat tasks, catch up on fast-moving discussions, and collaborate efficiently inside RingCentral Team Chat.

Note: As a Beta connector, functionality and server features may evolve based on community and user feedback.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RingCentral Chat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RingCentral Chat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.labs.ringcentral.com/ringex/v1.1.0/team-chat. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RingCentral Chat MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RingCentral Chat provides these MCP tools: about_ringcentral_mcp_tools, find_person, manage_adaptive_card, manage_chat_item, manage_incoming_webhook, manage_post, manage_team, read_team_chat, and send_post.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RingCentral Chat?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to RingCentral Chat in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does RingCentral Chat MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: RingCentral Chat requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
RingCentral Chat is developed by RingCentral, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
